one_page_notes.agnelmiranda: All FB hitter ahead. Lower slot RHP. FB SL to both sides, only 12% CH to LHH.
one_page_notes.alexclaudio: Heavy low slot sinker, CH mimics SNK movement, SL is cuttery. CH to RHH, SL to LHH
one_page_notes.alexsantos: Avg FB movement, good sweeper with lift and sweep. Cutter to LHH SW to RHH. Wide release
one_page_notes.alexuanvega: High FB usage, mixes some CB in. Not much rice, no run. Some sweep to CB and CH has some depth. 75%+ FB.
one_page_notes.andrewmarrero: Avg. ride on 4S, high release. SL has some sweep, 50/50 FB SL to RHH
one_page_notes.anthonyborrero: Avg slot, 40% SL to RHH, uses CH to LHH. Damage up and in to RHH and in to LHH.
one_page_notes.bradytedesco: Wide release LHP. High FB usage, some ride some run. High CH usage to RHH, CB to LHH. Some ride some run, slurve shape to CH, and CH not much depth with run, in upper 70s.
one_page_notes.charleesoto: Ride and run, short slider, most pitches move arm side. Damage up and in to LHH, middle to RHH.
one_page_notes.derekwest: High velo, avg 4S shape, some sweep to SL mid 80s uses more to RHH. Leans heavy FB and gets it in zone top rail. Damage middle up.
one_page_notes.ericgarcia: 4S and SL only - 4S no ride. SL is a short slurve. 75% FB
one_page_notes.erictorres: Run on FB, Sweeper to LHH, low/wide release
one_page_notes.erikrivera: Some ride on FB, short slider, high extension. Damage in to RHH.
one_page_notes.freddycabrera: Low velocity, high in zone rates. flashes both 2S and 4S in mid-upper 80s. High SL usage to RHH. Damage down and in to LHH and middle up to RHH.
one_page_notes.gabrielrodriguez: Ride on FB, low spin on splitter, wobbles - throws to RHH. high release. Short slider to LHH
one_page_notes.giovannisoto: Low slot LHP, high FB usage. Upper 80s, gets whiff on SL and CH. SL to LHH and CH to RHH. HIGH in zone rates in hitter ahead counts and almost always a heater.
one_page_notes.haroldcortijo: FB does not have ride, SL is gyro shape, CH has good depth and throws only to LHH
one_page_notes.harusenarita: High extension, high FB usage, mostly FB CT. High velocity up to 96. Damage middle away to LHH.
one_page_notes.hectorquinones: Damage down, average release height, SL to RHH, SP to LHH
one_page_notes.ivanhouellemont: Heavy FB usage, low velocity, damage away to both sides.
one_page_notes.jerryellrivera: High fb usage, low slot LHP. Cuts the heater, no ride, not much run. Good shape on sweeper, throws at 30% for both sides. Nothing arm side.
one_page_notes.johnaponte: Extension and low release height. works up with FB
one_page_notes.jonathanbermudez: FB average shape, primary offspeed big sweeper, average CH, flashes SL/CT shape vs LHH
one_page_notes.jorhanlaboy: Upper 80's LHP, CB and CH are offspeed pitches
one_page_notes.josecruz: FB SL to RHH and FB CH to LHH, up to low 90s, avg slot. RHH get extended, damage up and away, LHH damage middle in.
one_page_notes.juanmarcano: >50% FB, leans on SL to RHH, some CH to LHH
one_page_notes.juliocesarortiz: FB SL only but 75% FB. High velocity, has ride but can get hit if in zone even on top rail. SL is short like a cutter/gyro. Generally not in zone at all.
one_page_notes.julioortiz: FB SL only but 75% FB. High velocity, has ride but can get hit if in zone even on top rail. SL is short like a cutter/gyro. Generally not in zone at all.
one_page_notes.juliotorres: High FB usage, damage middle and in to RHH. Low velocity.
one_page_notes.kaiyokogawa: Damage away from RHH, down to LHH. Works CT CB SL and SP. Leans fb but throws all pitches
one_page_notes.lennytorres: Some ride and run, high velocity. short slider to RHH. Some SNK with some run no sink. CH has some depth.
one_page_notes.leonardorodriguez: High FB usage, damage in to both sides, top rail to LHH.
one_page_notes.lucasvega: High FB usage, low slow. Only uses SL as non-FB - some sweep.
one_page_notes.luisramos: Low slot LHP with extension, upper 80s with low 80s short SL.
one_page_notes.mariozabala: Good extension, some ride and short slider. High FB usage. See it up.
one_page_notes.matthewrivera: Even FB and CB usage (small sample). Normal release height.
one_page_notes.michaelmorales: Avg. ride, some cut to 4S. Good extension. Sweeper to RHH, CB/CT to LHH. CB has depth and sweep
one_page_notes.miguelcirino: Lives in zone to LHH, very high FB usage to LHH. to RHH more even between SL and FB, heavy SL usage with 2K.
one_page_notes.naritaharuse: High extension, high FB usage, mostly FB CT. High velocity up to 96. Damage middle away to LHH.
one_page_notes.noelpinto: Tons of FB, CH to RHH. Damage down in zone
one_page_notes.omarmelendez: High release, leans on FB, CH to RHH, spin to LHH
one_page_notes.randyramnarace: High slot RHP, Heavy fb usage. CB to LHH and SL to RHH. Cut ride to the FB and some life and sweep on SL. CB is slurve. SL is best pitch (up to 89). Damage away to RHH, middle to LHH.
one_page_notes.raulrivera: FB CH CB to LHH and FB CB SL to RHH. Upper 80s, not going to overpower. Damage middle up to RHH and middle down to LHH.
one_page_notes.rickycastro: Ride on FB, high release. CH has some depth, CT is primary BB. More SL to RHH, CH to LHH
one_page_notes.rubenramirez: Gets ahead and relies on FB. Damage middle away to both sides.
one_page_notes.ryanmunoz: High slot LHP. FB SL only, SL has depth and is scurvy. Damage middle in to RHH and same to LHH. Gets ahead and throws mostly SL unless behind in count.
one_page_notes.ryanmurphy: Hitch in delivery, SL for chase to RHH, SNK primary
one_page_notes.ryanvelazquez: High FB usage to LHH, mixes 30% SL to RHH. 50/50 SL FB in 1K counts, otherwise 30%. Ride and not much run. SL has gyro shape in mid 80s.
one_page_notes.ryderryan: Low FB usage. Uses SNK more. High SL usage to RHH and will throw both SL and CH to LHH. SL has some sweep in low 80s, SNK is heavy and has run up to 94. 4S shape not much ride, some run. CH has depth, similar shape to SNK and only 4 mph off. Funky release, opens front side early, low slow. Damage in to RHH and in to LHH.
one_page_notes.sidneyduprey: High extension LHP, more run than ride on FB. CB has some sweep and is smaller. Mostly FB.
